selectedOriginals.caption: Exterior view of the main jailhouse from the exercise yard of Alcatraz in San Francisco, CA.
selectedOriginals.inspection: Actual local2010 dining/exercise-yard stair photograph inspected: deep narrow exterior passage, rusticated lower concrete bands, large metal-grid windows, projecting end wing with two tall window tiers, lower doorway and stone steps. Yard wall and fence separate from prison facade.

selectedOriginals.caption: Alcatraz Island by Don Ramey Logan
selectedOriginals.sourceFamily: commons:alcatraz island photo don ramey logan.jpg
selectedOriginals.inspection: Actual local2013 island photograph inspected: full southeast prison frontage, distinct lower administration mass, central entry/armorial envelope, flat parapet and small roof monitor; separate tall lighthouse and ruined wardens house must not become part of this model. Shoreline, boats and vegetation are context, not footprint authority.

Entrance to Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary
additionalInspected.inspection: Actual local entrance photograph inspected: side doorway reached by a steel-railed external stair, gray masonry surround with shallow arched head and stepped cornice; tall gridded metal windows, plain concrete pilasters and molded parapet. Sign/tourists are not geometry.

additionalInspected.caption: Alcatraz cellhouse
additionalInspected.inspection: Actual local2004 cellhouse side photograph inspected: pale weathered concrete, long rhythm of pilasters, two tiers of large rectangular multi-pane barred windows, small inset panels below layered cornice and parapet. Concrete basement/retaining wall below the occupied floors; surrounding vegetation excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Alcatraz
additionalInspected.inspection: Actual local yard-side photograph inspected: dining block has projecting end bay and long two-window bays, two large upper window tiers over lower rusticated band with small windows; stepped cornice, flat parapet, narrow projecting metal roof rods and external pipework. Fine spalling and graffiti not copied.

additionalInspected.caption: Cell block at Alcatraz
additionalInspected.artist: Emily Mathews from Ann Arbor, MI
additionalInspected.inspection: Actual local rear/yard corner photograph inspected: dining wing joins cellhouse at a recessed corner; plain concrete pilasters, two tall upper window tiers plus smaller base lights, long lower retaining wall, stair/fence and weathered off-white render. Confirms attached massing rather than a gap inferred from native digitization.

additionalInspected.caption: Cell block and lighthouse at Alcatraz
additionalInspected.artist: Emily Mathews from Ann Arbor, MI
additionalInspected.inspection: Actual local full photograph inspected: southeast frontage, nine upper window bays, paired tiers, central entrance steps, plain pilasters with capitals, small circular frieze medallions and stepped parapet. Lower garden balustrades and tall separate lighthouse excluded.

additionalInspected.caption: Alcatraz
additionalInspected.inspection: Actual local2010 full photograph inspected: whole principal prison has central/lower southeast administration facade and staggered projecting wings, two tall side window tiers with pilasters/cornice. Integral western roof carries a broad short cylindrical cistern with shallow conical cover; it is distinct from the detached island water tower. Separate front raised vaulted cistern terrace, lighthouse and ruined wardens house are context.
